Name: BodyParts3D 4.0 (tcm-3d / Human Atlas)
Role_Function: Full multi-layer anatomical atlas viewer & mesh database
Attribution_ShareAlike_Terms: Attribution to DBCLS Japan and BodyParts3D required; No ShareAlike copyleft
Geometry_Origin: Segmented MRI/CT scans of standard adult Japanese male subject
Structural_Metadata: FMA (Foundational Model of Anatomy) Concept IDs (3432 mappings) + system labels + bounds
Format: atlas.json + 15 binary chunk buffers (body-0.bin to body-14.bin)
Hardware_Cost: Moderate (~150 MB GPU RAM; efficient chunk streaming)
Import_Export_Cap: High (JSON + binary buffers + BufferGeometry + Markdown export)
Blockers_Risks: None for research/PoC; binary chunk loader required in client

Name: Z-Anatomy (tcm-acupoints / hpfrei)
Role_Function: 3D Acupoint display on human skeleton/muscle mesh
Attribution_ShareAlike_Terms: Attribution required AND ShareAlike copyleft condition (viral license)
Commercial_Use: Restricted in proprietary commercial bundles due to CC-BY-SA copyleft
Layer_Coverage: Skeletal + partial musculature; Viscera incomplete; Skin absent/integrated
Structural_Metadata: English/Latin hierarchy node names without unified FMA ontology
Hardware_Cost: Requires Draco WebAssembly decompression at startup
Blockers_Risks: CC-BY-SA 4.0 ShareAlike copyleft blocks proprietary distribution; requires Draco WASM

Name: Anatomy-3D (WaterCMY)
Role_Function: Muscle distribution & acupuncture point 3D browser learner
Attribution_ShareAlike_Terms: Attribution to WaterCMY and BodyParts3D required
Layer_Coverage: Muscle (54 groups; 255 meshes) + skeleton; Organs ABSENT; Skin ABSENT
Structural_Metadata: Chinese/English muscle names; simplified semantic table
Blockers_Risks: Fails G2 layer coverage requirement (lacks visceral organs and skin layer)

Name: Acupuncture-3D-Authoring (Meridian Studio)
Role_Function: 3D skin meridian editor and geodesic path generator
Attribution_ShareAlike_Terms: Attribution to MaceLogice (male) and yuzutarou (female) required
Geometry_Origin: Artistic / 3D scan character meshes from Sketchfab
Layer_Coverage: Skin/Exterior ONLY (1 surface); Bone ABSENT; Muscle ABSENT; Organs ABSENT
Segmentation: Single continuous outer skin manifold per character
Reliability: Low for internal anatomy (Zero internal anatomical structures)
Blockers_Risks: Completely lacks bone; muscle; and organ layers; cannot serve as anatomical atlas

Name: TARA (Topological Atlas & Repository for Acupuncture Research)
Maintainer: NIH & Mass General Brigham & Harvard Medical School Consortium
Role_Function: Academic research standard-space 3D acupuncture topological atlas and ontology
Commercial_Use: Unknown / Restrictive without institutional licensing agreement
Layer_Coverage: Full theoretical coverage (Skin; Muscle; Bone; Viscera; Nerves)
Structural_Metadata: Advanced acupuncture ontology mapped to SNOMED/FMA
Import_Export_Cap: Low for browser WebGL without custom pre-processing pipeline
Blockers_Risks: QUARANTINE: Not available locally offline; licensing requires institutional clearance

Name: three-mesh-bvh (Garrett Johnson)
Role_Function: Spatial acceleration structure (BVH) for Three.js raycasting and surface snapping
Hardware_Cost: Low CPU construction; reduces raycast complexity from O(N) to O(log N)
Blockers_Risks: Optional performance optimization; basic Three.js Raycaster works out-of-the-box
